displayName: Mutant Mouse Resource and Research Centers (MMRRC)
summary: The Mutant Mouse Resource and Research Centers are the NIH-funded national repository network that preserves, validates, and distributes valuable mutant mouse models to the biomedical research community.
goals: show the value of national mouse resource infrastructure
ctaStyle: Point investigators toward strain access, submission pathways, repository tools, or supporting resources rather than generic brand CTAs.

topPerformingPatterns: National infrastructure framing performs well when tied to a concrete researcher benefit
Posts that mention reproducibility, QC, or access tend to feel more useful than awareness-only updates
weakSignals: Repository jargon without a researcher-facing explanation
Too many program acronyms in the opening line
correlations: Investigator-facing language about access, rigor, and preserved strains aligns with stronger engagement

topPerformingPatterns: Short posts naming a specific strain, tool, or resource update perform better
correlations: Concrete resource updates correlate better than broad descriptions of the consortium
